start.name: Start effect
start.description: Run a light effect on the targeted lights. Any other command to a light stops its effect.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 1 is normal, 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 half speed.

color.name: Colour
color.description: Base colour for single-colour effects (breathe, pulse, colorloop saturation).

stop.name: Stop effect
stop.description: Stop effects on the targeted lights, or on all lights if none are targeted.

restore.name: Restore
restore.description: Put the lights back how they were before the effect started.
